pages.note: Written 2026-10-09 to close MCP ledger entry 126 (extension_docs_search found only the manifest keys for 'Does Firefox support the side panel API?'). chrome.sidePanel signatures and versions read from chrome-types 0.1.453 (generated from Chromium IDL): namespace Chrome 114, MV3 only, permission sidePanel; open() and OpenOptions {windowId|tabId} Chrome 116; getLayout Chrome 140; close() and CloseOptions Chrome 141, no-op when closed, close({tabId}) rejects when only the global panel is open from Chrome 145; onOpened Chrome 141; onClosed Chrome 142; setOptions {tabId,path,enabled}; setPanelBehavior {openPanelOnActionClick}; no isOpen, toggle, title or icon method. Cross-checked on developer.chrome.com/docs/extensions/reference/api/sidePanel (close Chrome 141+, onClosed 142+, open from action click, keyboard shortcut, context menu, gesture on an extension page or content script; menu shows the extension icon). browser.sidebarAction versions read from @mdn/browser-compat-data 8.1.5: namespace and setPanel/getPanel/setTitle/setIcon Firefox 54, open/close 57, isOpen 59, toggle 73, chrome false, safari false. MDN pages read for open/close/toggle (handler for a user action), setPanel/setIcon (fails when tabId and windowId are both given), isOpen ({windowId}), and User_actions (the gesture list; a handler that awaits a promise loses user-action status). Matched the extension-dev skill references/cross-browser.md section 'Side panel / sidebar open behavior' (same toolbar sample, same asymmetry, same sync-call rule). Samples built with npx extension@4.1.33 build --browser=chrome,firefox in throwaway projects: toolbar sample emits only chrome.sidePanel.setPanelBehavior in dist/chrome and only browser.browserAction/sidebarAction in dist/firefox, no Gecko warning; context-menu runtime-branch sample prints 'background.js uses chrome.sidePanel, which is Chromium only.' on the Firefox build and still builds; the same sample with the isFirefoxLike build-time check prints no warning. A plain permissions list was replaced by chromium:permissions on the Chrome build (documented precedence), so the page lists contextMenus in both prefixed lists. A manifest with side_panel alone built for Firefox with sidebar_action pointing at the same page and the sidebarKeyTranslatedForBrowser warning, and the Chrome build did not add the sidePanel permission. Scanner regex read from programs/develop/plugin-web-extension/feature-manifest/steps/warn-gecko-unsupported-apis.ts. Not exercised: the panel opening in a live browser. The samples were built and their bundles read, not clicked.
